caption:
You run sales, delivery, and admin alone. Switching between apps to tweak a proposal or invoice costs hours every week. Gemini now lets you edit documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs directly in the chat. You stay in one window. You finish faster.

Open the Gemini app or website. Upload your draft, invoice, or tracker. Type your changes or highlight sections you want fixed. Expand to full screen to edit directly. Ask Gemini to adjust formatting, update totals, or rewrite paragraphs. Check the output carefully. AI can misread complex tables or miss subtle tone shifts. Always review before sending to clients.

Copy this prompt:
Upload my draft proposal. Keep the pricing table intact. Rewrite the scope section to be stricter about revisions. Adjust the tone to sound firm but professional. Generate the updated version.

This works for freelancers, consultants, and small operators who handle their own paperwork. It is free and available in every language where Gemini runs. Save this for your next client draft.

body.t: Direct file editing means changing documents without leaving the chat window.

The new Gemini editing tool works for every user in every supported language.
